annotation.title_clean: Projet de loi relative aux véhicules routiers à conduite automatisée
annotation.title_en: Draft Law on Automated-Driving Road Vehicles (Luxembourg)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics (Luxembourg)
annotation.venue: Luxembourg Chambre des Députés / Ministère de la Mobilité
annotation.summary_en: Luxembourg's draft law creating a legal framework for conditionally and highly automated road vehicles (SAE L3/L4+). It sets manufacturer duties, a declaration before circulation, licensed remote managers and operators, authorisation of automated transport services and automated parking, data recorder access, and allocation of criminal liability. Civil liability stays under ordinary law.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vehicles need EU/national type approval, registration and a prior declaration of circulation to the minister
Highly automated vehicles require continuous remote management by a ministerially licensed remote manager (5-year licence, insured, trained operators)
Automated transport services (robotaxis, shuttles, logistics) and automated parking facilities need ministerial authorisation
Criminal liability follows dynamic control: driver exempt when system active, manufacturer liable, remote operator treated as driver when intervening
Manufacturers must provide updates, report failures and share event data; Technical Investigation Administration may investigate accidents; civil liability left to common law and product liability
